AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire
devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings
are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. Audit Reports are available for viewing by clicking here. For
public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a
specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have any question
about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Management Services
Department at (818) 548-4844, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JULY 27, 2023 AT 2:00 PM

1.  ROLL CALL

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the July 27, 2023 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on July 24, 2023,
  on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
   Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on January 26, 2023
  b. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 27, 2023

5.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  b. Election of Audit Committee Secretary
  c. Annual Report to City Council

6.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 6/30/2023 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  b. FY 2023 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2024 Audit Work Plan – Jessie
  Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  c. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30, 2023 –
  Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

8.  NEW BUSINESS

9.  ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  July 27, 2023

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 PM
  Present: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy
  Absent: Jack Mavyan
2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:
  A. Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of July 27, 2023 was posted on
  July 24, 2023 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on January 26, 2023

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian  Seconded: Alejandro Parajon
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy
  Noes: None
  Absent: Jack Mavyan
  Abstain: None

  B. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 27, 2023

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian  Seconded: Thomas O’Shaughnessy

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy

  1
   Noes: None
  Absent: Jack Mavyan
  Abstain: None

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  Note: Agenda Item 5 was taken out of order and presented prior to Agenda Item
  4.

  A. Election of Audit Committee Chair

  There was a brief discussion on selection of the Audit Committee Chair. Mr.
  Alejandro Parajon expressed his interest in becoming the Chair if there are no
  other contenders. Mr. Thomas O’Shaughnessy nominated Mr. Parajon to be the
  Audit Committee Chair. No other nominations were made.

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy
  Noes: None
  Absent: Jack Mavyan
  Abstain: None

  B. Election of Audit Committee Secretary

  Mr. Thomas O’Shaughnessy nominated staff from the Management Services
  Department to continue providing staff to act as Secretary of the Audit
  Committee. No other nominations were made.

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy
  Noes: None
  Absent: Jack Mavyan
  Abstain: None

  C. Annual Report to City Council

  All Committee members including the Audit Committee Chair noted that they had
  read the Annual Report to City Council. Audit Committee Chair moved to approve
  the report.

  Moved:  Seconded:

  Vote as follows:

  2
   Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy

  Noes: None
  Absent: Jack Mavyan
  Abstain: None

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  Note: Agenda Item 6C was taken out of order and present prior to 6A.

  C. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30,
  2023 – Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager
  Ms. Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager, introduced Daphne Munoz,
  Partner at CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP, who subsequently presented the report on
  the Audit of FY ended June 30, 2023 to the Audit Committee and answered
  questions from the Committee members.
  A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 6/30/2023 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit
  Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on June 30, 2023.
  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the
  Water System Pipeline Management Program FY 2021 Agreement Audit. Ms.
  Minami-Valdivia and Mr. Richard Ruyle, Water Services Administrator, answered
  questions from the Committee members.
  Ms. Ani Antanesyan, Sr. Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the Insight
  Public Sector Inc Contract Audit. Ms. Antanesyan and Ms. Michelle Nall, Utility
  Business System Support Administrator, answered questions from the
  Committee members.
  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor made a presentation on the PCI
  Compliance Audit and answered questions from the Committee members.
  After the audit presentation, Ms. Zhang continued presenting the Internal Audit
  activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress, continuous
  audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory
  services and answered questions from the Committee members.
  B. FY 2023 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2024 Audit Work
  Plan – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  Ms. Zhang provided a report to the Audit Committee on the FY 2023 Audit Work
  Plan Status Update and the FY 2024 Proposed Audit Work Plan and answered
  questions from the Committee members.

  3
 7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Mr. Thomas O’Shaughnessy once again expressed interest in having Ms. Lucy
  Varpetian provide training on the Brown Act for the Committee Members. Ms.
  Jessie Zhang expressed her appreciation for the dedication and effort that City
  staff and Audit Committee members bring to the Committee. Chair Parajon
  echoed Ms. Zhang’s statements.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  It was brought up by several Committee members to review other available times
  for the Audit Committee meeting to accommodate committee member schedules.
  Audit staff noted that a report on available times for the Audit Committee meeting
  will be brought to the Committee for consideration.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Alejandro Parajon  Seconded: Thomas O’Shaughnessy

  Adjournment at 4:19 PM
